verdict.rationale: The webhooks docs describe configuring endpoints that fire when jobs complete, fail, or change state, as an alternative to polling job status. The getting-started docs frame parsing as jobs across SDKs, CLI, and REST API, so the core non-blocking async pattern is documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the async submit and status-polling endpoints (the only code sample is a blocking-looking parse call), detail on webhook payloads, retries and signing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
